CustomField.description: Optional template of the display name of the created segments, which must contain the {segmentValue} placeholder (e.g. EMEA - {segmentValue}). Left empty = the segment value itself. Existing segments are matched on the resulting name.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional template of the display name of the created segments, which must contain the {segmentValue} placeholder (e.g. EMEA - {segmentValue}). Left empty = the segment value itself. Existing segments are matched on the resulting name.
CustomField.label: Segment Name Template
